items.name: Manabolt
items.description: Simple Sorcery + WIL Test. Lethal mental damage, DV = Net hits. Living/astral targets only.

items.name: Stunbolt
items.description: Simple Sorcery + WIL Test. Stun mental damage, DV = Net hits. Living/astral targets only.

items.name: Blast
items.description: Opposed vs Athletics (ranged defense) + AGI. Physical DV = WIL + Net hits. 1 Edge: knock target down.

items.name: Flamestrike
items.description: Opposed vs defense. Physical fire DV = WIL + Net hits. 1 Edge: ignite target.

items.name: Ice Spear
items.description: Opposed vs defense. Physical cold DV = WIL + Net hits. 1 Edge: slow target.

items.name: Lightning Bolt
items.description: Opposed vs defense. Physical electrical DV = WIL + Net hits. 1 Edge: target loses 1 action.

items.name: Acid Stream
items.description: Opposed vs defense. Physical acid DV = WIL + Net hits. 1 Edge: degrade target armor.

items.name: Analyze Magic
items.description: Instantly identifies active spells, foci, spirits, or magical phenomena.

items.name: Analyze Truth
items.description: Reveals whether the target believes their spoken statements are true.

items.name: Mind Probe
items.description: Touch target to extract one known fact per Spellcasting Test.

items.name: Borrow Senses
items.description: Touched subject perceives through a visible target's senses.

items.name: Combat Sense
items.description: Subject gains Advantage on Close Combat and Athletics (ranged defense) Tests.

items.name: Detect Enemies
items.description: Senses living beings with hostile intent (2/4/6/8 hits = Close/Short/Med/Long).

items.name: Detect Life
items.description: Senses living creatures mouse-sized or larger (hits set range band).

items.name: Detect Magic
items.description: Senses active astral forms and dual-natured entities (hits set range band).

items.name: Heal
items.description: Heals one wound box or stabilizes a dying target (one spell attempt per box).

items.name: Increase Reflexes
items.description: 3 hits: +1 Edge/scene & unlimited extra actions; 5 hits: +1 action/narration; 7 hits: +2 Edge/scene.

items.name: Chimera
items.description: Multi-sensory illusion in an area affecting both living observers and sensors.

items.name: Confusion
items.description: Targets with WIL+LOG <= net hits suffer Disadvantage on all Tests.

items.name: Invisibility
items.description: Renders subject invisible to eyes and sensors; Perception + LOG vs net hits to see through.

items.name: Mask
items.description: Alters subject's appearance to another similarly sized look.

items.name: Silence
items.description: Suppresses all sounds emitted by the subject.

items.name: Phantasm
items.description: Creates a realistic multi-sensory mental illusion (sensors immune).

items.name: Control Thoughts
items.description: Targets with WIL+LOG <= hits suffer Disadvantage on social Tests and act on implanted suggestion.

items.name: Armor
items.description: Grants +1 physical Armor per 3 hits.

items.name: Astral Armor
items.description: Grants +1 Armor against magical/astral attacks per 3 hits.

items.name: Mystic Armor
items.description: Grants +1 Armor against both physical and magical attacks per 4 hits.

items.name: Elemental Aura
items.description: Melee attackers dealing physical damage suffer elemental damage equal to net hits.

items.name: Levitate
items.description: Lifts and moves target at walking pace just above the ground.

items.name: Physical Barrier
items.description: Creates a solid translucent wall blocking physical attacks and movement.

items.name: Magic Fingers
items.description: Telekinetic manipulation of objects at range using Sorcery hits.

items.name: Shaping
items.description: Reshapes raw physical materials (stone, earth, metal, water) within line of sight.
